# 🐛 Bug Report

## Before You File
- Search [existing issues](https://github.com/janavipandole/Cara/issues) to avoid duplicates.
- For security vulnerabilities, please read [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) instead.

## Affected Page / Feature
Which page or feature does this bug occur on?
> e.g. `checkout.html` – order summary sidebar

## Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce
Ordered steps to reliably reproduce the bug.
1. Open `shop.html`
2. Add a product to the cart
3. Navigate to `checkout.html`
4. Observe the order summary shows ₹0.00

## Expected Behavior
What should happen instead?

## Actual Behavior
What actually happens? Include screenshots or console errors where possible.

## Environment
| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Browser(s) | Chrome / Firefox / Safari / Edge / Mobile |
| Device Type | Desktop / Tablet / Mobile |
| OS | Windows / macOS / Linux / iOS / Android |
| Node.js Version | e.g. v20.11.0 |

## Console Errors
```bash
Paste any browser console errors here
```

## Additional Context
Any other context, screenshots, or screen recordings that help explain the problem.

## Pre-submission Checklist
- [ ] I searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate
